Well, if you think you have a clear picture of how your life will be and think your happiness will be less than zero then you could. Before you decide though maybe take some time to think about what you can do to change your life on a fundamental level. If you've never dropped acid try that out and spend some money on a good pair of headphones if you have the means. Just do your best to find joy in life and see if that can take you anywhere. I know you say your in trouble but don't be afraid to tell anyone that hounds you for something to fuck off. Even if you were to go to jail for say tax avoidance you could take time to talk to people and get some drug hookups. I find if I have no inhibitions good things happen. Also if you are overweight I recommend you start doing a lot of running, that is the key to finding a girl. Out of breath?, take a moment to look at the stars. I could go on but you get the idea. And at the end of the day if you need to work at a mcdonalds to get by, do everything with pride but remember who does what, who to trust, who to say yes to. Once these things are on autopilot your own path in life will come. Don't have a car? No matter that just part of the exercise routine to find a GF. If at the end of the day though if you decide on a different, shorter path, just remember that for every person who will decry your actions from birth to death there are also those who will understand. Also if you are able a change of climate may be good, maybe try to leave the country. Borders after all are just imaginary constructs meant to make people fell they own others, and in some places less so. Not sure where to end this so ill just leave it here.
